mask-transform.reason: ControlBounds limits source capture before filtering. The translated scope starts at x=12; the fixture rectangle is bounded at that edge rather than contributing out-of-bounds pixels.

style-bevel-emboss.reason: Generated blend-contribution metadata includes Bevel HighlightMode/HighlightOpacity and ShadowMode/ShadowOpacity. The old analyzer omitted the backdrop required by the default Screen and Multiply contributions.
